bug_semantics: tcprewrite --fixlen pad heap use-after-free: untrunc_packet reallocs the packet buffer, then tcpedit_packet still passes the stale ip6_hdr pointer into fix_ipv6_checksums, which reads freed IPv6 header bytes (CWE-416).
flaw_origin: 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 first added safe_realloc inside untrunc_packet for --fixlen pad while callers kept ip6_hdr into the old heap buffer. Parent 16abc7fe749bd3c130204d0b2707caf7cab5894e padded in place with memset and never freed that buffer. Later *pktdata writeback (b58b23a5) and PACKET_HEADROOM (64132c54) still realloc. 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da (Bug #970) removed the realloc; maintainer could not reproduce #972 on 4.5.2-beta3 because that fix was already in tree. CVE-2025-9385 remains PUBLISHED (CVE.org) / Analyzed (NVD), not withdrawn.
evidence: Sink is fix_ipv6_checksums in src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c, called from tcpedit_packet after untrunc_packet. Issue #972 ASan on 6fcbf0324088561d95c356fe8337f4faac275f1a (merge of 4.5.1): READ in fix_ipv6_checksums:155 of memory freed by realloc in untrunc_packet:562 via our_safe_realloc; trigger `tcprewrite --fixlen pad`. At 6fcbf03 untrunc_packet still does packet = safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len + PACKET_HEADROOM) when len > caplen, then later uses the original ip6_hdr. git log -S safe_realloc -- src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c: 69831b81 adds realloc, 73008f26 removes it. 69831b81 is a single-parent 2014-07-22 commit by Fred Klassen <fklassen@appneta.com> (same committer), message 'remalloc packets before padding to ensure not overwriting memory - closes #80'; git cat-file -p shows no Co-Authored-By / Generated-with / bot author. git cat-file -e 16abc7fe:src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c succeeds; parent untrunc_packet took u_char *pktdata and memset(pktdata + caplen, 0, len-caplen) with no realloc. 69831b81 changed the signature to u_char **pktdata and inserted packet = safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len) without refreshing ip6_hdr. 73008f26 (author/committer Fred Klassen <fred.klassen@broadcom.com>, 2025-08-18) deletes that realloc, adds MAX_SNAPLEN check on pkthdr.len, CHANGELOG '--fixlen use-after-free (#970)'; ancestor of v4.5.2. Maintainer comment on #972 (2025-08-19) cannot reproduce on 4.5.2-beta3. GHSA withdrawn_at is null; CVE.org state PUBLISHED; NVD vulnStatus Analyzed. ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: numactl git show 69831b8^:src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c untrunc_packet used 'memset(pktdata + pkthdr->caplen, ...)' with no realloc while BIC 69831b8 changes signature to 'u_char **pktdata' and adds 'packet = safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len)' — the realloc-induced stale ip6_hdr vulnerability new at BIC. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
reasoning: The vulnerability is real: ASan shows a heap UAF on the IPv6 checksum path after --fixlen pad realloc. The smallest first-write of the realloc that invalidates ip6_hdr is 69831b81, not a later headroom/writeback tweak and not the 2009 IPv6 merge. Parent tree still has untrunc_packet and fix_ipv6_checksums but pads in place, so no free. The direct fix is removing that realloc in 73008f26; #972 is the IPv6 manifestation of the same #970 mechanism. BIC commit object is human (Fred Klassen, 2014) with no AI markers, so NOT_AI. Later AI, if any, is irrelevant. Advisory is not withdrawn/rejected, so not FALSE_POSITIVE.
